manifest_row.title: In Nova Scotia, Bill and Ted debate the risk of an offshore oil disaster

screening.main_topic: Debate over offshore oil and gas drilling off Nova Scotia, including its risks, economic arguments, and place in the transition away from fossil fuels.
screening.climate_relevance: The report connects new fossil fuel development to climate change, the need to shift toward renewable energy, and Canada's Paris Agreement commitments. It also presents competing views about continued oil and gas development.
screening.reason: Although offshore drilling and its local environmental and economic risks are the immediate focus, climate change and the broader debate over fossil fuel infrastructure are substantial themes throughout the article.
